notes: Names and text of unit skills (army units, monsters, hired soldiers). The numbers stay on each unit in units.json (skills[]), because one skill can be stronger on a stronger unit.
kind: active (the unit uses it by itself in a fight; the player can also press it on an own unit) | passive (always on) | work (workers only).
target: none (around the unit) | unit (one target). targets: enemy | ally (who a unit target may be).

effect: the code that runs (abilities.ts useSkill); default is the skill id. bolt = spell damage (+ slow), curse = slow + more spell damage taken, ward = armor for an ally, slam = damage (+ stun) around the unit.
The HUD shows these when a player selects or points at a unit. Own units show active skills as buttons.

skills.name: Gather
skills.text: Brings gold from a mine and wood from trees to the Town Hall.

skills.name: Build
skills.text: Builds new buildings for the kingdom.

skills.name: Repair
skills.text: Fixes damaged buildings.

skills.name: Mend
skills.text: Heals a hurt ally. Works in and after a fight.

skills.name: Pack Howl
skills.text: Allies nearby deal more damage for a while.

skills.name: Screech
skills.text: Slows all enemies nearby.

skills.name: Web
skills.text: Roots an enemy: it can not move for a moment.

skills.name: Rock Slam
skills.text: Hits the ground: damages and stuns enemies nearby.

skills.name: Stone Guard
skills.text: Takes less damage from spells.

skills.name: Chill Burst
skills.text: A burst of cold slows all enemies nearby.

skills.name: Faith Ward
skills.text: A shield of light gives an ally more armor.

skills.name: Hex Bolt
skills.text: A cursed bolt hurts an enemy.

skills.name: Bog Curse
skills.text: Swamp mud slows an enemy, and spells hurt it more.

skills.name: Ice Shard
skills.text: A shard of ice hurts and slows an enemy.

skills.name: Ember Flare
skills.text: The wisp flares up and burns enemies around it.

skills.name: Troll Blood
skills.text: Wounds close fast: more health back every second.

skills.name: Shatter Armor
skills.text: A maul strike reduces the target armor for a short time.

skills.name: Rune Shot
skills.text: Fires a charged rune bolt at the current enemy.

skills.name: Null Screen
skills.text: Briefly grants nearby allies resistance to spell damage.

skills.name: Reliquary Link
skills.text: Takes part of the protected ally damage while the guard stays close.

skills.name: Captain Banner
skills.text: Nearby allies gain armor. Equal banners do not stack.

skills.name: Lantern Mend
skills.text: The lantern staff heals the most injured nearby ally.

skills.name: Veil Cleanse
skills.text: Removes one harmful effect and grants a short spell barrier.

skills.name: Bulwark Cover
skills.text: Nearby ranged troops take less damage from ranged attacks.

skills.name: Demolition Slam
skills.text: A hammer shockwave damages and briefly stuns nearby ground enemies.

skills.name: Repair Tools
skills.text: Nearby workers repair buildings faster.

skills.name: Shelter
skills.text: Nearby defenders regenerate health after leaving combat.

skills.name: Chain Arc
skills.text: Lightning jumps through a cluster of enemies.

skills.name: Frost Pulse
skills.text: Slows nearby ground enemies.

skills.name: Bell Interrupt
skills.text: A bell pulse silences nearby enemies and interrupts casting.

skills.name: Sticky Pitch
skills.text: Slows ground enemies stepping into the basin.

skills.name: Wind Gust
skills.text: Pushes back airborne enemies.

skills.name: Pylon Cover
skills.text: Briefly protects nearby defenses against ranged attacks.

skills.name: Boar Charge
skills.text: Charges the current ground target. Roots, stuns and blocked terrain stop it.

skills.name: Drum Rhythm
skills.text: Nearby allies attack faster. Equal drum auras do not stack.

skills.name: Arrow Roof
skills.text: The covered ram takes much less damage from ranged attacks.

skills.name: Piercing Bolt
skills.text: A huge bolt pierces a narrow line of ground enemies.

skills.name: Bodyguard
skills.text: Shares part of a nearby ally damage while the badger stays close.

skills.name: Trail Mark
skills.text: A marked shot reduces armor and reveals the enemy.

skills.name: Coalback Repair
skills.text: Repairs a nearby injured allied construct or siege engine.

skills.name: Bomb Run
skills.text: Drops a short line of bombs on ground enemies. Cannot hit air.

skills.name: Place Lantern
skills.text: Places one destroyable healing lantern near the novice. It stays in place and expires.

skills.name: Lantern Light
skills.text: Nearby allied units regenerate health. Equal lantern auras do not stack.
